title: Internship Onboarding Checklist
content:
1. Review Month 1 requirements
2. Set up Git repository
3. Implement modular tools in Python
4. Write automated tests with pytest
5. Prepare documentation for GitHub submission

title: Useful Python Commands
content:
Run tests: python3 -m pytest -v
Run app: python3 main.py
Check syntax: python3 -m py_compile *.py

title: Productivity Goals
content: Focus on high code quality, modular architecture, robust error handling, and clean CLI UX.
